scripts.dev:full: ([ -f .dev.vars ] || cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars) && VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=${VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY:-1x00000000000000000000AA} npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/verify-site.mjs
